Title: 什么是推理模型
Subtitle: 通过训练与求解计算改进任务表现，最终答案仍需独立核验
Upper slim explanatory strip with THREE meaningful labeled components, not a mandatory workflow:
“训练任务” / “反馈与强化学习” / “推理时计算”
Small line “推理研究涉及多种方法，更多求解计算并不自动保证正确。”
Main composition: left about45% a concrete teaching problem, right about50% independent check.
Left heading “一道可验算的小题（教学构造）”
Question “鸡兔同笼，共8只、22条腿，鸡和兔各有多少只？”
Small assumption “按每只鸡2条腿、每只兔4条腿计算。”
Use restrained blue line-art chicken/rabbit symbols, not fake photographs.
Large clear ANSWER pair “鸡5只” and “兔3只”. These numbers are the answer, not benchmark results.
Right heading “独立核验：把答案代回条件”
Three clear check rows, each equation large:
“数量” / “5 + 3 = 8”
“腿数” / “2 × 5 + 4 × 3 = 22”
“取值” / “均为非负整数”
End check label “所有条件同时满足，答案通过核验。”
Below a small deliberately wrong counterexample:
“反例：鸡4只、兔4只”
“数量虽为8只，但腿数为24，不满足22条腿。”
Lower practical row heading “不同任务，选择不同验证方式”
“数学：验算” / “代码：运行测试” / “事实：核对证据”
Bottom bold takeaway “解题文字写得完整，不等于结论正确；要检查可复现的结果。”
Page25. Show only problem, proposed answer and public external verification. Do not describe, display, simulate or claim access to any model's internal thinking. No transcript of hidden thoughts, no invented solve time, model scores or model responses. This is a self-contained classroom example, not a real product benchmark.

Title: 从文字到多模态
Subtitle: 既要看能理解哪些输入，也要看能生成哪些输出
Main LEFT about62% an INPUT/OUTPUT TASK MATRIX, professionally designed, navy header with small relevant modality icons. Header first cell “输入＼输出”, remaining columns “文本”“图像”“音频”“视频”.
Rows exactly:
“文本” | “问答／改写” | “文生图” | “语音合成” | “文生视频”
“图像” | “看图问答” | “图像编辑” | “—” | “图生视频”

RIGHT about33% use the actual documentary image from input2, showing a technician repairing server equipment. Preserve actual person, face, pose and hardware, do not recreate a different person. Place clean photograph about x970y390width420height280 on white backing. Caption “真实场景输入示例”.
Under photograph:
“图像 → 文本”
“教学任务：描述设备检修场景。”
“这里展示输入与任务，不声称是模型实测输出。”
Lower full-width two concise mechanism rows, semantic relevant linework rather than arbitrary decoration:
“自回归” / “逐步预测后续表示单位”
“扩散” / “逐步去噪，形成生成结果”
A compact supporting line “不同模态可采用不同机制，也可组合；多模态不等于统一生成路线。”
Bottom bold takeaway “先说清输入和输出，再判断系统是否具备所需的多模态能力。”
Page26. Do not cite AlphaFold3 as evidence of media generation; no human clone/voice impersonation, fabricated system output or product endorsement. Matrix includes understanding and generation deliberately; distinguish them in subtitle and notes. Keep letters and Chinese spacious, no crowding.

Title: 模型使用形态
Subtitle: 将模型获取方式与部署位置分开考虑，再按任务需求选择
Upper conceptual relationship, clear but concise:
“在线API” / “通过接口调用已部署服务”
“开放权重” / “可获取模型参数，依许可使用”
“本地部署” / “在自己控制的设备中运行模型”
Connect open-weights to either self-deployment or hosted-service as simple branches, showing dimensions overlap. Do not present these three as mutually exclusive model classes.
Main comfortable comparison table with five columns (four comparison dimensions plus row labels):
“组合方式” | “数据处理位置” | “维护责任” | “硬件要求” | “许可与条款”
Rows exactly:
“服务商托管API” | “服务商环境，核对区域与保留策略” | “服务商维护基础设施；使用方负责应用治理” | “通常无需自备推理硬件” | “核对服务条款与数据约定”
“开放权重＋自有部署” | “自有设备或私有云，配置决定边界” | “自行维护模型、系统与安全” | “按模型配置硬件与容量” | “核对权重许可及使用限制”
“开放权重＋托管服务” | “所选托管环境” | “与托管方划分责任” | “通常无需本地推理硬件” | “同时核对模型许可与托管条款”
Keep table readable with wrapped cells and generous row height, no tiny text.
Below TWO meaningful caution rows:
“开放权重 ≠ 训练数据、代码与许可全部开放”
“本地部署仍需维护、访问控制、日志与安全治理”
Bottom bold takeaway “选择形态要结合任务效果、数据边界、资源和维护能力。”
Page27. No legal opinion on a particular license, no claim API always leaks data or local always secure, no product branding or endorsement, no simplistic best/worst ranking. Strong flat academic layout, can simplify incidental icons while preserving content.

Preserve axes, curve, year labels2024/2025, endpoint66.30% and human baseline72.35%; do not invent points, alter scale or redraw values. Crop whitespace margins only if useful.
